- to buy a first home costing £450,000 or less, provided the account has been open for at least 12 months

claims: Transfers are started by the receiving provider, which here would be us.
items.before:
Possibly, yes. It depends on the type of scheme.

- **Defined contribution workplace pension:** Our self-invested personal pension (SIPP) accepts transfers from these. It also accepts transfers from other personal pensions.
- **Defined benefit (final salary) scheme:** Transferring out is a significant decision. If the transfer value is more than £30,000, the law requires you to take independent advice from a firm with Financial Conduct Authority permission to advise on pension transfers. Fernhill Wealth holds that permission. The FCA expects advisers to start from the assumption that a transfer won't be suitable. We recommend one only where we can show it is clearly in your interest.

Transfers are started by the receiving provider, which here would be us. Pension transfers typically take four to eight weeks. The receiving scheme carries out the required checks. It may require you to take guidance from MoneyHelper if the checks raise an amber flag.

I can't say whether a transfer is right for you. If you'd like to talk it through, I can pass you to an adviser. More detail is on our pensions guide: https://www.fernhillwealth.example/guides/pensions/
items.after:
Here is a corrected version, using only what the documents say.

Our self-invested personal pension (SIPP) accepts transfers from other personal pensions and from defined contribution workplace pensions.

Transferring out of a defined benefit (final salary) scheme is a significant decision. If the transfer value is more than £30,000, the law requires you to take appropriate independent advice from a firm with Financial Conduct Authority permission to advise on pension transfers. Fernhill Wealth holds that permission. The Financial Conduct Authority expects advisers to start from the assumption that a transfer will not be suitable. We recommend one only where we can show it is clearly in your interest.

Pension transfers typically take four to eight weeks. The receiving scheme carries out the checks required by the pension transfer regulations. It may require you to take guidance from MoneyHelper if the checks raise an amber flag.

The source is https://www.fernhillwealth.example/guides/pensions/
items.note: receiving provider is us for a transfer in; rewrite dropped the no-advice line and leaked
